[[Violence in the Streets (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Violence in the Streets map.jpg|160px]] }} The [[Jade Brotherhood]] and [[Am Fah]] are in open war in [[Wajjun Bazaar]], and the [[Ministry of Purity]] are on their way. Try to find a way to stop the bloodbath. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Find a way to end the fighting. * See [[Guardsman Qao Lin]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,500 [[Experience]] *1,000 [[Gold]] *[[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] *[[Imperial Commendation]] ==Walkthrough== Speak to Guardsman Qao Lin again, who will transport your party to a Wajjun Bazaar infested with Ministry, Jade Brotherhood and Am Fah. Head straight west towards the docks. You will encounter two groups of hostile [[Ministry of Purity]] [[NPC]]s that are battling other hostile foes. To make the fight easier, wait until the Ministry of Purity has defeated the other hostiles before engaging them. At the docks you will encounter a large neutral [[mob]] made up of [[Am Fah]] and [[Jade Brotherhood]]. After a short discussion, [[Reisen the Phoenix]] and [[Apep, Unending Night]] will turn hostile. Defeat both, then watch the conversation to finish the quest. === Alternative === A: It is possible to run to the location of Reisen the Phoenix and Apep, Unending Night, avoiding any fighting yourself. After the dialogue reaches the appropriate stage, the two will fight, and then you can lure the nearby Ministry of Purity group to the bosses to finish off the last one. [[Spell targeting prevention|Spell target]] protection may be useful. B: The only required kill is Reisen the Phoenix. Stay on the south side of the bridge directly away from the mob only Reisen the Phoenix will turn hostile. Use a hero to lure him onto the bridge without the rest of the mob becoming hostile. Once he goes down, just wait for the dialogue to finish and the quest to update. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== Humans ([[Ministry of Purity]]) (Only during the escape) *{{w}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry dialogue=== ;Guardsman Qao Lin :''"Thank goodness you've returned! Just when I thought things couldn't get any worse...it seems like the Jade Brotherhood and the Am Fah are each trying to capitalize on the fact that the other has been weakened by the [[Ministry of Purity]]. They're using this opportunity to try and put an end to their rivalry. The streets of [[Wajjun Bazaar]] are being overrun!.{{sic|punctuation needs to be verified in-game}}"'' :''At this rate, it's only a matter of time before the Ministry of Purity comes down on them, and tries to wipe them both out in one fell swoop. I'd say "Good riddance to them," but...fighting on this scale? A lot of innocent people are going to get hurt, and the Imperial Guard doesn't have the numbers left to intervene. We can only rely on you, friend. This fight needs to be stopped, in any way possible. Will you help?"'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I will bring an end to their brawling with my superior fighting. | decline = Oh, just let them kill each other off. What the Ministry of Purity began, I'm going to finish!"'' :'''Apep, Unending Night:''' ''"So you think, but your numbers speak differently. But know that the Ministry of Purity has no love for those that meddle in the affairs of Cantha."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Guardsman Qao Lin :''"The Am Fah and the Jade Brotherhood both turned and fled? Something about that doesn't feel right to me. But no doubt, the Ministry of Purity is going to be crowing about this as their great victory, routing the gangs from Cantha. I can only hope that this is the end of it. Eradicating the Afflicted, I completely understood. The gangs, I could understand the reasoning behind going after them. But who else could be left for them to persecute? Maybe...just maybe, they'll have finally got what they wanted, and things can begin to settle down. Am I sounding a little too optimistic here? I hope not.'' :''I let myself get sidetracked. You should go speak with your friend, the assassin. She said she would be waiting in the Shenzun Tunnels for you. She looked like she was up to something. Now I'm back to worrying again."'' ==Notes== {{bug|The [[quest log]] fails to mention the experience and gold rewards.
